About

For D to complete. Nothing here is published until you write it. Suggested points, in your own words and only what's accurate:
  • Your name and how you'd like to be described
  • Your finance and complaints-handling background (roles, years, any qualifications you actually hold)
  • Why you built this: HMRC's list tells you what's compatible, not what suits you
  • Whether you are or aren't a qualified tax adviser (important for trust and compliance)
  • A contact email

What this site is

A plain-English, independent comparison of software HMRC recognises for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, built from HMRC's own list and the providers' own websites.

What this site isn't

It isn't HMRC, it isn't connected with any government body, and it doesn't give tax advice.
